title: Room for Improvement: Needs a Better Lid
text:
Room for Improvement: Needs a Better Lid. I selected this coffee tumbler because we do go through coffee in the house and a tumbler this size is good for making iced coffee drinks (for those that like that kind of stuff) and for those that like a big cup of coffee (that would be me). This cup is not ideal; the main issue I have with it is the lid.

First off, this is a very large tumbler. The average I have seen in tumbler size is 20-24oz. This one is a full 30 ounces and that’s a lot of coffee if you fill it up. That’s not a problem at all, but be aware of this before you purchase. I like this size because it allows me to put the amount of coffee in that I want and leave some room at the top to add creamer if I want it and to put the lid on without spilling.

Ah, the lid… This is the weak spot in this tumbler. The lid has a slider that opens up the lid to reveal an inadequately small hole through which the coffee flows. I found myself frustrated quickly with this and I replaced the lid with one from another tumbler, after which all was right in the world. This is unfortunate; almost every lid I have gotten with other tumblers – including smaller ones – has a larger drinking hole in the top.

Another issue which does not affect me much but will definitely be a problem for others is the shape of the tumbler itself. Most I have seen have been shaped such that a third-party handle can be attached and the tumbler then can be carried around like a regular coffee mug. The smooth sides don’t permit that. If you have to have a handle for your coffee cup, this one will not do. This is a personal preference, and probably impacts those who drink coffee in the car more than anyone else.

Finally – mine came with a nice dent in it. Doesn’t affect usability, but it’s still very unfortunate and I'm not happy.

There is room for improvement with this tumbler. The size is great for me, though some might not want one this big. The lid needs to be rethought, though, which is the biggest problem with it.
